title: Eosinophil–NLR interaction fails to improve transferred elevated-CRP prediction beyond flexible CBC main effects
abstract: In NHANES 2003–2004 to 2007–2008 transfer, a centered log-eosinophil × log-neutrophil/lymphocyte interaction did not improve weighted prediction of CRP >3 mg/L: Brier improvement -0.00006927 (95% joint rescaled PSU-bootstrap interval -0.00111693 to 0.00015793). Negative result for a single physiological interaction tested in separate temporal probability samples; not clinical or causal evidence.
